Hi, I have been around formal systems for decades (think: 001, Scade, VHDL) and just entering a learning curve for lean4.  If anyone has a recommendation for a "1-page poster quick reference for lean4 idioms" would be much appreciated.   Current interests in applied applications for rigid geometry, physics, fluid mechanics.
